title: Whisper Fine-Tuning
motto: Whisper is a 30-second-window transformer encoder-decoder, trained on 680k hours of multilingual weakly-supervised audio-text pairs. One architecture, multiple tasks, robust across 99 languages. The 2026 reference ASR.

steps.title: Core idea
steps.body: Whisper is a 30-second-window transformer encoder-decoder, trained on 680k hours of multilingual weakly-supervised audio-text pairs. One architecture, multiple tasks, robust across 99 languages. The 2026 reference ASR.

steps.title: Why this matters
cards: Whisper, released by OpenAI in September 2022, was the first ASR model to ship as a commodity: paste audio, get text, 99 languages, robust to noise, runs on a laptop. By 2024 OpenAI had shipped Large-v3 and Turbo variants; by 2026, Whisper is the default baseline for everything from podcast transcription to voice assistants to YouTube subtitles.
